name: Stillness
overview: Scripture calls believers to embrace stillness as an expression of trust and reverence toward God. Moses instructs the people to stand still and witness the Lord's salvation, emphasizing reliance on God's power rather than human effort (Exodus 14:13-14). Job is urged to pause and reflect on God's wondrous works (Job 37:14), while the Psalmist encourages resting in the Lord and patiently waiting without anxiety (Psalms 37:7). Ultimately, stillness is portrayed as a posture of recognizing God's sovereignty and exaltation, as expressed in the command to 'Be still, and know that I am God' (Psalms 46:10). This quiet confidence opens the way to deeper understanding and revelation of God's truth (Psalms 119:18).
